notes.title: Update #9 : Endgame, Part I
notes.content:
After a month of work I'm happy to bring you the biggest update yet! Six new enemies, two more levels, a new boss, and loads more features, tweaks, and bug fixes! Hope you enjoy all the new content.

On a more technical note, steam integration has been temporarily disabled, as it seemed to be causing problems with Windows 10. I'll be working hard to try to fix this so we can have high-scores and achievements again, and hope everyone understands. As always, full changelog below

[b]FEATURES[/b][list]
[*]Two more zones; a star system and a space station
[*]Six new enemies. The Mystic Priest, Mystic Warrior, Gun Drone, Sentry Drone, Welding Automaton, and Assault Automaton
[*]A new boss, the High Mystic Grigori
[*]Molten planets with fireball-spewing volcanoes
[*]Advanced KaasTau boss for the 4th and 5th systems
[*]A new Master item, Blood Roots. Killing multiple enemies within 10s will heal you.
[*]Procedurally generated space stations
[*]Merchants talk to you, making small talk and occasional hints
[*]Mutagens to mix up your stats, both in good and bad ways
[*]Randomly generated foreground nebulas[/list]


[b]BALANCE[/b][list]
[*]Viktor has approximately half a second of Invincibility when activating his beacon
[*]Sentry guns in the Space Stations shoot less but deal more damage
[*]Slightly decreased Ebzer Pickpocket speed
[*]Fire slugs have 20% shorter trails
[*]Optical Array has diminishing returns
[*]Recolored and balanced the Large Brain Ooze. It leaves no trail but takes multiple button presses to remove
[*]The time penalty to score ignores the first minute
[*]Fixed Grigori's teleportation sprite
[*]Adjusted message box position
[*]Some tweaked art in the space station background
[*]An extra destinations available from the space station
[*]More interesting nebula shapes
[*]Decreased odds of jungle, sentient, and scrapyard planets
[*]Removed a decoration for crystal planets
[*]Switched audio format for smaller file size[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES[/b][list]
[*]Steam integration temporarily disabled
[*]Nadia's Bomb Jump challenge should track properly
[*]Fixed 'ds_map not found' crash in space station
[*]Fixed possible crash when shooting destroyed enemies
[*]Fixed possible crash when shooting Crystal Moths
[*]Fixed missing surface crash in space station
[*]Ebzer Pickpockets always track you instead of pausing
[*]Multiple suns display properly on minimap
[*]Lighting scales better with multiple suns
[*]Killing the Mastermind now increases score 
[*]Hyper Lens shows proper image
[*]Text alignment fixed on shop items
[*]Text on the Annihilator's HP bar aligns properly
[*]Screen tear shader works properly on the main menu
[*]Camera starts tracked on player in station
[*]Larger texture pages for Windows 8+[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build #8!
notes.content:
Hi there! I hope everyone had a great holiday season, but now that it's over it's time for more updates! A bunch of new items, tiny bug fixes, and balance tweaks dominate this update. Of course, new items require some new deadly wildlife...

Finally, the most obvious thing for this update is a minimap in the top right of the screen. I'm not 100% sure this is a good idea, so please let me know what you think. There's still a few weird bugs floating around that I'm trying to hunt down, and here's the update log below:

FEATURES
[list][*]A Minimap, showing the players place amongst the local solar system as well as planets with items, shops, and bosses.
[*]Universal GPS and Psionic Hood now interact with Minimap
[*]New passive item, Hyper Lens, which reveals more of the map around you
[*]Several new active items: Fuel Reserve and Stimpack which give you a one-time-use cache of supplies, and Land Mines and Toxic Cloud for some more ways to deal damage
[*]A new deadly enemy lurking on gas giants, the Methane Worm[/list]

BALANCE
[list][*]Better looking planetary rings
[*]Decreased Health drop rate
[*]Bomb Crystals don't spawn on merchant planets 
[*]Fuel Pumps & Medical Stations cost less
[*]Enemy Missiles have an indicator when off screen instead of moving the camera (This one might almost count as a feature)
[*]Ebzer Seeker fires a regular missile instead of a super missile
[*]Removed Fuel Crystal passive item
[*]Increased poison tick frequency
[*]Reduced cost of Incinerator Drones and Chance Amulet 
[*]Elastic Ooze now has diminishing returns[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list][*]Fixed Quantum Resonator being permanently active
[*]Static appears when Brain Slug'd
[*]Ebzer Seeker is no longer resistant to explosives
[*]Ebzer Annihilator's stun attack pauses properly
[*]Tutorial planets have new planet graphics
[*]No more Asteroids in the Item Shrine
[*]Dialogue boxes pause properly
[*]Fixed Poero Bomber's throw and hurt animations[/list]

notes.title: Update #7 : Achievements!
notes.content:
After a long delay punctuated by a hard drive failure comes the first pass of Steam integration! Sixteen glorious achievements for all your achieving pleasure, and a global high-score board with which to show off your prowess. Most of the achievements should be pretty easy to get for experienced players, but harder achievements will come with late-game content. Please let me know if there's an issue with either the scoreboard or achievements, since this is my first time working with the Steam API.


In addition, the final early/mid game alien race has been added; the KaasTau. These machine-plant hybrids already had two enemies in the game, but now have four new spike-throwing, laser-shooting, player-slowing enemies, topped off with a deadly boss. As always, full changelog below:

Features
-Sixteen Steam Achievements!
-Scoring system with a global high-score board. I can post the breakdown of the score calculations if people are interested.
-KaasTau completed, with four new enemies and a boss
-Many planets have improved graphics, with more contrast and noise
-Audio and gameplay settings can be adjusted from the pause menu

Balancing
-Shopkeeper is immune to explosives
-Item shrines decreased to 75% chance of that item class
-Item shrine text displays for 50% longer
-Megalith's slam attack has sound
-Cluster bombs nerfed
-Better walk cycle for KaasTau Crawler
-Increased glowing planet's attack cooldown
-Ebzer Annihilator has less HP at lower levels

Bug Fixes
-Emmy no longer slides backwards on ice after dodging
-Music properly configured in audiogroups
-No crash after defeating Cyborg Salvagers
-Ebzers will dodge roll away from Nadia's melee attack
-Fixed challenge unlock issues with Viktor and Nadia
-Fixed bug where sunlight wouldn't clear between stages

notes.title: Early Access Update #6
notes.content:
Another new character this update, Emmy Wolfe. Her jump-jet dodge gives her plenty of mobility and two machine pistols send out loads of bullets wherever you aim, albeit with plenty of bullet spread. Even more exciting are the Item Shrines; two gates scattered across the galaxy take you to a planet where you can manipulate item drops. Change the odds to drop more offensive, defensive, or utility items to fit your playstyle. Invincibility frames, new items and enemies, and extra animations round out the update, with the complete changelog below:

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*]Yet another new character, Emmy Wolfe! Unlocked by trading with Merchants, she has two fast-firing machine pistols and jump jets to launch through the air.
[*]Item Shrines! You can bias the RNG to give you mostly offensive, defensive, or utility items. For a cost...
[*]Idle animations after being stationary for 7 seconds
[*]After taking damage, there's now 0.67 seconds of invincibility
[*]Four new Advanced Items: Titanium Shield, Red Shroud, High-Tech Salvage, and Opulent Bracelet
[*]New enemy, the Poero Grenadier
[*]Two new encounters when using the Emergency Beacon
[*]Occasional meteor showers in the background[/list]

[b]Balance & Misc[/b][list]
[*]Different drops for early game bosses
[*]Increased Shield and Health Ore spawn rate
[*]Decreased Energy Ore spawn rate
[*]Increased Viktor's movement speed by 16%
[*]Nadia only requires 10 deaths to unlock
[*]Dynl Dancer has a narrower knife spread
[*]Reflected shots are less dangerous
[*]Fire Hive has more HP and a new fire attack
[*]Reduced Gravity Wallet to +20% gem drops
[*]Increased Autolaser firing rate by 16%
[*]Chance Amulet now does +17% Critical instead of x2
[*]Surviving minions leave after beating the Dynl Master or Grandmaster
[*]All Poeros take 66% less damage from Explosives
[*]Moved active items down on the GUI
[*]More background Nebulas
[*]Item pedestals get fancier with higher tech level[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Going to the Supernova no longer crashes game
[*]Nadia's swing size increases with range increases
[*]Fixed typo in Blood Merchant dialogue
[*]William's Extra Ammo challenge saves properly[/list]

notes.title: Update #5 - Nadia and Major Rebalancing
notes.content:
Wow, it feels like it's been too long since I've uploaded a build. This update was supposed to come out last week but loads of miscellaneous bugs and hardware issues delayed it until now. Sorry about that. Apology out of the way, here's the awesome news! A brand-new character, Nadia, is in the game, fighting with high-explosives and a hefty wrench. It took a bunch of work to make a melee character work, since until she came around everything was balanced against ranged characters, but she's turned out to be my favorite character (so far). 

Also, there's two major balance adjustments. First, shields have been nerfed, with the maximum temporarily decreasing as you take damage and resetting with fuel use. To compensate for this, combat items have been buffed about 25%. Second, merchants give better and better trades the more you interact with them, but killing any merchant resets that progress. [*]Faster drop-down when on platforms
[*]Cyborg Salvagers will not summon walls if players are too close
[*]Decreased scaling costs of Fuel Pumps and Health Stations
[*]New platform layout with the Heimdall AI
[*]Lowered volume of William's teleport sound
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4 - Seeds, Plants, and Challenges!
notes.content:
The biggest update yet! Several new items, from the low-level buffs to ridiculously powerful late-game enhancements. The first creatures of a brand-new alien race, the KaasTau are scattered around the galaxy as well; symbiotic plant-machine hybrids with a focus on summoning and ranged attacks.

Most exciting though, is character progression! Each character has three challenges, from resource gathering, defeating bosses, moving quickly, or finding secret areas. Completing a challenge gives items, resources, or special maneuvers. Let us know what you think!

[b]Content[/b][list]
[*]Each character has 3 challenges to complete for some extra firepower, resources, or tricks
[*]Pause menu displays controls and play time
[*]Seeded runs with 36^8 possible seeds
[*]Three new basic items: Decennial Bloom, Photosynthesis Gland, and the Combat AI
[*]New superpowerful items as late-game Boss rewards.
[*]Three of the KaasTau[/list]

[b]Balance[/b][list]
[*]William is unlocked earlier, after reaching the Space Station
[*]Health drops are more forgiving, with a chance of drops as long as you're not at full HP
[*]Changed solar system sizes; smaller early game, larger late game
[*]Increased Supernova countdown by 50s
[*]Decreased Shield Ore spawns
[*]Viktor's Shield Beacon gives 3 temporary shield
[*]Shield Beacon has slightly larger radius
[*]Heimdall AI's main cannon shots are slower and weaker[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Gun recoil will no longer pull you forward
[*]Play time no longer increases while loading or paused
[*]Jumping between planets resets Emergency 
[*]Fire Slugs should no longer grow arbitrarily large
[*]Emergency Beacons don't trigger on the Space Station[/list]

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Moonstrider's been out for a week now and I'd like to thank all of you for your comments, bug reports, and ideas. It really means a lot to know that people are playing this.

As for the update, it's not a very flashy one, but has a lot of behind-the-scenes work. Most obvious is that the gui will scale properly on 1080+ monitors. More important though, is that seeds are now easier to control, laying the framework for daily updates in the future. Beyond that, just bug fixes and the usual tweaks. To make up for the smallish update, here's a preview of an upcoming alien race:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bNtkR4o.gif[/img]
 
[b]Content[/b]
-Lots of new enemy combinations
-Pause menu displays the seed
-Harder to accidentally quit with controller
-Tweaks to the options menu

[b]Balance[/b]
-Harder to get items from killing the Shopkeeper
-Higher chance of unlocking Viktor

[b]Graphics[/b]
-Small portrait of William added to character selection
-Crystal Moth Wings reset to default color on most planets
-Joystick icon animates properly
-Shaper Fuel Merchant animates properly

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-GUI scales properly on all 1080p monitors
-Improved wall collisions
-Fixed dialogue display when unlocking Viktor
-Drone displays correct cost
-Removed some obsolute music files

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Version 2 of Moonstrider is here! Some major changes this update, primarily to the game economy. Gems are a bit rarer and there should be more interesting decisions to be made. Plenty of item tweaks, a windowed mode, and all reported bugs are (hopefully) fixed. Let us know what you think of the changes!

Balance[list]
[*]Bosses drop no gems, slightly less health
[*]Merchants drop more gems on death
[*]About 5% less fuel ore spawns
[*]Slightly increased stronger ore spawn rates
[*]Tweaked ore refining values
[*]More interesting options for stronger ores
[*]Significantly buffed Incinerator Drone
[*]Decreased Megalith stun range by 15%
[*]Buffed the Mechasign
[*]Killing a merchant causes no merchant to appear next level
[*]Changed Optical Array to +33% view distance
[/list]
Graphics[list]
[*]Windowed mode. This hasn't been extensively tested yet, so please let us know of any glitches if you're using this
[*]Controls now visible on character selection screen
[*]Active Use items have a blue aura
[*]More impact when the player is damaged
[/list]
Audio[list]
[*]Made Poero Drone and Hazard Warning sounds quieter
[*]Fixed rocket boots sound looping on tutorial
[/list]
Misc[list]
[*]Finishing the tutorial starts the main game
[/list]
Bugs[list]
[*]Fixed use item icons scaling in the gui
[*]Can no longer mine resources while upside-down
[*]Rebound use item keys don't display when not in use
[*]Jumping while picking up Jetpack no longer crashes
[*]Merchant & Item boxes no longer generate a glitch item
[*]Dynl Warrior should no longer grow huge
[/list]

notes.content: The first of what should be many updates to come! No major changes here, just fixing several audio balance issues, a bug or two, and a little bit of graphical polish to hopefully make the GUI more intuitive. It didn't feel like quite enough content to merit Version 2, so 1.1 it is. Unless any game-breaking bugs arise expect Version 2 sometime next week!
